headline: The job is in the field. The chaos is in your inbox.
lede: BuildGrid is the coordination pack a project manager on a small or mid-size build actually opens on Tuesday morning — RFI log, 3-week look-ahead, punch list, and submittal tracker. One payment. Digital files. Reuse it on every job.

inside.title: RFI log
inside.body: Number, date, question, assignee, due date, closed. So the architect question from Thursday does not vanish into a text thread when the inspector shows up.

inside.title: 3-week look-ahead
inside.body: Crew-level schedule the superintendent can mark up. Not a 400-line P6 export nobody reads in the trailer.

inside.title: Punch list system
inside.body: Room-by-room items, owner, photo note, sign-off. Walks stop dying in a group chat the week before turnover.

inside.title: Submittal tracker
inside.body: Spec section, status, reviewer, return date. Ends the sentence “I thought you had that.”

without: RFIs live in email, texts, and a spreadsheet named FINAL_v7.
Look-aheads are rebuilt from scratch every Monday.
Punch items get lost between the walk and the closeout binder.
Subs swear a submittal was sent. You cannot prove when.
withThis: One log the whole job can point at.
A look-ahead that matches how the site actually works.
Punch that survives the walk, the photos, and the owner meeting.
Submittals with a date trail you can show the architect.
notFor: Teams that need live multiplayer SaaS with seats and SSO.
Enterprise PMOs replacing Procore or Autodesk.
People looking for a course. This is a working pack, not a lecture.

faqs.a: Editable templates: RFI log, 3-week look-ahead, punch list, and submittal tracker — plus a one-page how-to so a new PM can start the same day. Not a locked PDF of theory.
No. It is a digital pack you own. Open it in Excel, Sheets, or the equivalent you already use on the job. No login, no monthly seat.
Project managers and supers coordinating subcontractors on small and mid-size builds — where email is still the operating system and a $40k platform is not happening this quarter.

faqs.q: What if the files are not what I needed?
faqs.a: Email care@buildgrid.com within 14 days if the download is defective or you cannot open the files. We do not invent reviews or customer counts.
